title.rendered: Google Gemini AI Plus 1-Year Free Offer on Internshala: Check Who Qualifies

content.rendered:
Learn how to get Google Gemini AI Plus free in 2026 for 12 months via Internshala. Check Indian student eligibility, Gemini features, 400 GB storage, and claim steps.

New Delhi: Google and Internshala have rolled out an exclusive promotional offer allowing eligible Indian college students to claim Google AI Plus free for 12 months. Hosted through the official Internshala campaign page, this 1-year extended trial unlocks upgraded Gemini AI capabilities, NotebookLM research tools, Gemini integration inside Google Workspace apps, and 400 GB of cloud storage at zero subscription cost for the first year.

For students, coders, and job seekers preparing for placements in 2026 and 2027, knowing how to get Google AI Plus free in 2026 provides access to paid AI tools normally priced at ₹399 per month in India. Because eligibility depends on account verification and promotional terms, candidates must complete their Internshala profile accurately before redeeming the offer.

About the Internshala and Google AI Plus Partnership

Internshala is India’s largest student career and internship platform, connecting millions of college learners with verified internships, skill trainings, and student perks. Through its collaboration with Google, Internshala enables verified Indian college accounts to unlock a 12-month promotional trial of Google AI Plus.

Access to Google AI Plus helps students accelerate academic research, debug programming code, generate study flashcards, and draft ATS-ready resumes using Google’s latest AI ecosystem without paying monthly subscription fees during the 1-year promotional period.

Google Gemini AI Plus Free Offer: Key Highlights

What You Get with Google AI Plus (Features & Benefits)

Claiming this 1-year offer upgrades your personal Google account with productive AI and storage benefits:

  • Higher Gemini AI Limits: Enjoy expanded access to Google’s advanced Gemini models for coding assistance, logical reasoning, mock interview preparation, and complex research.
  • Gemini Inside Google Workspace: Use AI directly inside Gmail, Google Docs, and Google Slides to draft emails, summarize notes, and build presentations faster.
  • NotebookLM Research Assistant: Upload lecture PDFs and study notes into NotebookLM to generate summaries, revision flashcards, and audio overviews.
  • 400 GB Cloud Storage: Get 400 GB of Google One storage across Google Drive, Gmail, and Google Photos, shareable with family members.

Eligibility Criteria of Google Gemini AI Plus

Google and Internshala enforce strict account checks before activating the 12-month free trial. Verify these conditions first:

Who Can Apply?

  • Indian College Students: The Internshala promotion is intended for eligible college students located in India.
  • Complete Internshala Profile: Your Internshala student profile must be fully filled out with accurate college name, degree, and graduation year details.
  • Eligible Google Account: Redemption is limited to one offer per Google account. Users who currently hold an active paid Google One / AI Plus subscription or belong to a Google family plan with an active subscription may not qualify.

Important Payment Verification & Auto-Renewal Rules

  • ₹2 Refundable Verification: During Google checkout, you must add a valid Indian payment method (UPI, debit card, or credit card). A nominal ₹2 authorization charge may be processed and refunded automatically.
  • Renewal After 12 Months: This is a 12-month promotional trial, not a permanent free plan. Starting in month 13, Google automatically bills ₹399/month unless you cancel the subscription in your Google Play / Google One settings before the trial ends.

How to Claim Google Gemini AI Plus in 2026 (Step-by-Step)

Follow these exact steps to check your eligibility and activate your 1-year subscription:

  1. Open the Official Offer Page: Visit the Internshala Google Gemini AI Plus Offer Page.
  2. Sign In or Register: Log in with your Internshala student account (or create a free account using your student email).
  3. Update Your Education Profile: Ensure your college name, course, and expected graduation year are saved properly in your Internshala profile.
  4. Check Offer Availability & Claim: Navigate to the Offers section or click Claim on the Google AI Plus banner if your account qualifies.
  5. Redeem on Google Checkout: You will be redirected to Google’s redemption screen. Verify that the screen clearly displays ₹0 for 12 months, complete the ₹2 payment method verification (UPI or card), and activate your plan.

1. Who is eligible for the Google AI Plus 1-year free offer on Internshala?

Eligible Indian college students with a completed Internshala student profile (including college and graduation year details) can check and claim the 12-month promotional offer on an eligible personal Google account.

2. Is Google AI Plus completely free for 12 months?

Yes, eligible students get 12 months of Google AI Plus at ₹0 subscription cost. A nominal ₹2 verification charge may apply when linking a payment method during checkout, which is refunded automatically.

3. What happens after the 1-year free trial ends?

After 12 months, the subscription automatically renews at the standard rate of ₹399 per month unless you cancel it in your Google subscription settings before the renewal date.

4. What features are included in Google AI Plus?

Google AI Plus includes expanded access to Gemini AI models, NotebookLM, Gemini integration inside Gmail and Google Docs, and 400 GB of Google One cloud storage.

5. Do I need a credit card to claim the Internshala Google AI Plus offer?

No, a credit card is not mandatory. Google checkout in India supports UPI and eligible debit cards for the ₹2 refundable payment method verification.

6. Where is the official link to claim Google AI Plus free in 2026?

You can check your eligibility and redeem the offer directly through the official Internshala campaign page at internshala.com/google-gemini-ai-plus.
